description: Review Focus 1: at 120 km/h the player's settled full lock (steer = the car's ComputeSteerScale(120), the speed-scaled value the player's branch applies) without the handbrake for 1.5 s turns the car 45 degrees or more and it stays upright (up Z > 0.7). SEDAN on the drive strip in the gear the auto-box holds at its start speed, raw AI controller (unsmoothed, unscaled inputs), the car ticking after the test, physics in step with game time (time dilation 0.25).
